Join Deloitte China Deloitte China provides integrated professional services to our clients with a one-stop shop offering of world-leading audit, tax, and consulting services. • We are the world's largest professional services firm that changes the world, leading with purpose and shared values. • We are market leader in digital and innovative solutions, creating value for client through our multi-disciplinary services. • We are certified as one of the ‘Best Workplaces™ in Greater China and recognized as a Top Employer in China by the Top Employers Institute* since 2006！ Consulting provides enduring value to the world's most important organizations. With 7000+ consulting and delivery practitioners, Deloitte consulting delivers innovative solutions through Strategy, Risk & Transactions and Technology & Transformation. Across disciplines, we connect the optimal mix of Deloitte's industry, functional and technology capabilities with the best of our Alliances to orchestrate the outcomes our clients seek. We aspire to be our clients' Most Valuable Partner, with our people, platforms and AI integral to creating shared value at the heart of their business. China Japan Collaboration Analyst Role Description To navigate the future with confidence, organizations need to make the right choices: clear, timely and inspirational choices that deliver growth in a dynamic, disrupted world. Monitor Deloitte's strategy practitioners have combined deep industry insights with cutting-edge methods to help leaders resolve their most critical decisions, drive value, and achieve transformational success. As an Analyst in the China Japan Collaboration team, you’ll join a highly collaborative team in a fast-paced environment that exposes you to a variety of experiences across industries (Automotive, Consumer Products & Retail, Life Sciences & Healthcare, Insurance, Oil Gas & Chemical, TMT, etc.) disciplines, and geographies. You will work alongside industry-leading clients to help them make decisions and implement enhancements to their strategy, productivity, performance, and long-term profitability. You will have the opportunity to exercise strong analytical and critical thinking skills to solve complex problems and communicate your findings to senior leaders. As an Analyst in the China Japan Collaboration team, you are comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy learning quickly to make an impact. You will be successful by demonstrating a breadth and depth of capabilities to take on a variety of business, technological and organizational challenges. Examples may include helping clients define their strategic direction based on analyzing structured and unstructured data; sensing market and technology trends to anticipate changes and make strategic choices; implementing new innovations and ventures; re-designing business capabilities; and architecting innovative operating models to drive organic growth. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with cross offering portfolio teams at Deloitte Consulting on end-to-end Digital, Analytics and Cloud transformations, to help some of the largest and most innovative organizations address their most complex and pressing business challenges, and deliver concrete results. Your success will be enabled and empowered by Deloitte Consulting's broad platform that puts talent first. We invest passionately in trainings and coaching to guide you through your Deloitte career. Most importantly, we are a caring community that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
